text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYBEAN SALE - USDA said private exporters reported sales of 108,000 tonnes of soybeans to Taiwan for 1997/98.

WHEAT SALE - Egypt's official commodities buyer said on Sunday he bought between 200,000 to 215,000 tonnes of U.S. soft red wheat at prices ranging between $136.75 to $137.30 for delivery in September. All prices were FOB.
SOYMEAL SALE - Chinese buyers were said to have defaulted on 150,000 tonnes of soymeal bought from the United States due to falls in soymeal futures prices, traders said.

"There are three shipments, totaling about 150,000-tonnes, of U.S. soymeal (that have) been defaulted by some Chinese buyers," a U.S. trader in China said. Dealers said Chinese buyers had bought over 500,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal at a price of around US$300 a tonne C&F for nearby delivery, but some started to default on their purchases.
CORN/SOY TENDER - Taiwan is expected to tender for up to 108,000 tonnes corn and 54,000 tonnes soybeans this week.
CORN/SOY TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender on July 29 for a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes U.S. corn and 12,000 tonnes U.S. soybeans, traders said.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC was seeking on July 30 up to 3,530 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Honduras. Shipment period was set Aug 15-Sept 5.
- The CCC was seeking on July 29 up to 4,100 tonnes of U.S. Hard Red Winter wheat for donation to Bosnia. Shipment period was slated for Aug 15-Sept 5.
- Pakistan would be seeking on July 28 a total of 500,000 tonnes optional origin wheat for August 11-Sept 10 shipment.

VEGOIL TENDERS - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries was seeking on August 19 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

- El Salvador said it was seeking about 4,000 to 5,000 tonnes prime bleachable summer yellow (PBSY) cottonseed oil in bulk and about 750 to 1,250 tonnes sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480, Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said. Offers are to be received by July 29 and remain valid until July 30. The shipment dates for both commodities were slated for September 10-25.

VEGOIL, RICE, FLOUR TENDERS - The CCC was seeking a total of 10,470 tonnes of rice, vegetable oil, sunflower oil and all purpose flour for donation to Kyrgyzstan, Georgia and Bosnia. Offers for all commodities were due August 6. It was was tendering 1,500 tonnes rice in 50 kg bags for Kyrgyzstan, 750 tonnes vegetable oil and another 1,450 tonnes vegetable oil, packaged in plastic bottles for Kyrgyzstan. It also included 2,695 tonnes of sunflower oil for Georgia and 1,250 tonnes sunflower oil for Bosnia. It also comprised 1,075 tonnes all purpose flour for Georgia and 1,750 tonnes flour for Bosnia. Shipping period was set for Aug 21-Sept 5.
MARKET TALK - Japanese corn importers are seen stepping up their buying of U.S. corn this week ahead of the mid-August holiday season, deales said on Monday.
... Brazil exported 1.11 million tonnes of soybeans in June, down 38.3 percent from May, inspection company SGS do Brasil said.
